name: Jiangdu District

queries.query: Jiangdu District China official cadastral parcel map real estate registration natural resources
queries.result: Discovery found the official Jiangsu one-window real-estate registration platform. Its current public configuration identifies Jiangdu District under Yangzhou and provides a Jiangdu-specific service route; the route redirects to a Yangzhou government-service login page. No anonymous parcel viewer or parcel geometry API was found.

registryBasis: The official Jiangsu registration configuration explicitly names 江都区 under 扬州市 and assigns it a district-specific official service route. This evidences an official local registration-service context, but not open cadastral geometry access.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official Jiangsu one-window registration landing page retrieved. The server-rendered page is a service selector; no parcel map/API endpoint or safe parcel geometry was exposed in the page.
requestsAndEndpointChecks.evidence: The page identifies the Jiangsu one-window real-estate registration service and links its public JavaScript configuration.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Current public configuration retrieved. It lists 扬州市 and 江都区, code 321012, with href https://zrzy.jiangsu.gov.cn/hlw-web/sso/redirect/page/yz. No service schema, CRS, parcel layer, or anonymous geometry endpoint is included.

The configured Yangzhou route redirected to https://yzs.jszwfw.gov.cn:9086/epoint-web-zwdt/yzzwdt/denglu/denglu?appid=04681b9b-f48a-45ee-9713-e47ed4cc2007 and returned a user-login page. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, token acquisition, or post-login requests were attempted.
A direct Jiangdu government-domain check timed out; this is an unavailable route in this attempt, not evidence of source absence.

technicalBlocker: No public anonymous map/API route returning a safe parcel identifier plus geometry was exposed. The configured Yangzhou route is a login wall.
remainingUncertainty: The exact WUP point was not tested against a parcel service because no qualifying anonymous endpoint was discovered. This is not evidence of citywide parcel absence. The coordinate was retained exactly and not shifted.
nextStep: On a later attempt, locate a current officially documented public Jiangdu/Yangzhou cadastral viewer or spatial service, then request only a bounded area with safe parcel identifiers and geometry. Independently qualify any adapter before runtime admission.
